final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM rating_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length, r.avg_length - o.avg_length AS difference FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE r.avg_length > o.avg_length), above_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(a.difference) AS avg_difference_from_overall, AVG(a.avg_length - b.avg_length) AS avg_difference_from_above_average FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN above_average b WHERE a.avg_length > b.avg_length
